rationale: Both catch the single confirmed major bug (varlen_func=None crash on masked path, matching RuixiangMa's comment) with good detail, but neither surfaces the doc/version-requirements question, test-marker requests, or the false-pass-via-try/except CI concern that reviewers actually raised. X reviewed a post-merge tree that had diverged from the PR diff (self-disclosed), weakening strict groundedness, and its version=int claim, while plausible, is speculative and unverified. Y's extra finding (unguarded default get_kernel call making the RuntimeError dead code) is sharply grounded in the exact diff shown and independently verifiable, giving it a precision edge despite similar recall and actionability.
